title: SIGN OFF
author: Sangeeta Dey ( Roy)
text:
Beneath the wide smile ,

Behind the loud laughter,

Below the fine velvety textures of the words ,

Besides the vibrant demeanor

Of your statue .

I can see dried eyes ,icy aura, fractured words and still heart.

Masquerading as an elixir ,as a breezy song, with honeyed grace.

Were you trying to stitch,mend and repair with your efforts,
Only to exhaust you,
Weigh you down,
Without an iota of reciprocation.

Maybe your silence could have resounded more louder .

And then you could have signed off
effortlessly.
